description.en: Sivatherium giganteum: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m length ART SETTING. Basu2016 Fig1 NHMUK composite of 26 adult bones from at least three individuals, not single complete specimen. Authors restored torso ribs pelvis and phalanges comparatively with Giraffa; missing jaw and soft tissue, ears, tail, coat, colour, widths, ossicone skin and minor lobes are artistic inference. No exact scan or complete fossil claim.
